acs.text_first_line: AC1 The Helm chart and values deploy rwb-comms with its own login and the per-service migration
AC2 The egress to EasyApp runs through the ACE common module path with referenced credentials
AC3 The subscriptions carry retry and .dlt and the retry is the platform relay JOB-11
AC4 The dashboards carry the request, send and result series
AC5 The alerts fire on a stuck send and on a result that never arrives
AC6 The runbook covers a stuck send, a down egress, a missing result, an unknown reference and a growing exception queue
AC7 The SIT smoke profile runs the journey against the fakes
AC8 The feature switch and the rollback are safe
